title: Which of the sixteen grocery and household items in the Kellesay Retail Prices Index move from shelf-price collection to the three supermarkets' transaction data in the January 2027 index, an item moving when its 12-month rate to September 2026 from the transaction data is within 1.5 points of its published rate; with each supermarket's average days to complete monthly records and each item's 2025 coverage of household spending
subdomain: seasonal-adjustment-official-time-series-production (official time-series production: a monthly retail prices index compiled from supermarket transaction records, conformed into product-months and set against the published index over a parallel year)
prompt_shape: 10: a scorecard of sixteen items against the 1.5-point line (lines compared, transaction-data rate, published rate, difference, move or stay), with each supermarket's timeliness, each item's coverage, a chart of each item's two indices and the conformed product-month file
